newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FLAT VS MARK, FIRMS ON DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FLAT VS MARK, FIRMS ON DOLLAR.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 995-995.50 per mark, flat from the opening's 994.90-995.50, after calm interbank trade and amid low foreign currency demand from banks and clients, dealers said.
* The lev rose to 1,839-1,842 per dollar from the morning's 1,847-1,850 following a firmer mark/dollar rate on global markets.

* The lev was pegged at 1,000 per mark as an anchor in a the currency board system, a form of IMF-prescribed fixed exchange rate mechanism introduced on July 1 to restore confidence in the lev and stabilise the economy.
* Under the currency board the central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of the anchor currency at 995 levs bid and ask of 1,000. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
